headline: Deadlocked adopts the shared OpenRAC source layout and GPL-3.0
summary: Deadlocked reorganises shared and level-specific source and near misses to follow Ratchet & Clank's layout (#2). It adopts GPL-3.0 while retaining library notices, fixes container and documentation details, and brings over contributor queue tools. The day changes organisation and tooling rather than reporting a new coverage gain.
